title: 2006 North Korean nuclear test
description: North Korea's first nuclear weapons test, conducted at the Punggye-ri site. Estimated yield <1 kt — widely considered a partial fizzle.

title: 2009 North Korean nuclear test
description: Second North Korean test. Estimated yield ~2–6 kt. Confirmed by USGS seismic detection (4.7 mb).

title: 2013 North Korean nuclear test
description: Third North Korean test. Estimated yield ~6–9 kt, possibly using highly enriched uranium for the first time.

title: January 2016 North Korean nuclear test
description: North Korea claimed this was a hydrogen bomb test. Yield ~7–10 kt — too small for a true H-bomb; analysts believe it may have been a boosted fission device.

title: September 2016 North Korean nuclear test
description: Fifth North Korean test. Estimated yield ~10–25 kt — largest yield up to that point.

title: 2017 North Korean nuclear test
description: Sixth and most powerful North Korean nuclear test. Estimated yield ~100–250 kt, consistent with a thermonuclear (H-bomb) device. Caused observable surface deformation at Mount Mantap.
